purpose: Test whether V105's remaining lower-rank LoadLeast regressions are caused by moving work to a node with worse CPU or memory headroom despite nonworse aggregate FaaSRank, OCS, LoadLeast, welfare, input-locality, warmness, and downstream-locality certificates.

v105_mechanism_diagnosis.interpretation: All first harmful scalar substitutions passed aggregate welfare, FaaSRank, OCS, and LoadLeast certificates. Full five-component FaaSRank Pareto safety was inert. Input locality, current warmness, downstream warm-child locality, and global score safety are already independently frozen, leaving CPU and memory headroom as the isolated untested component safety dimensions.

closed_axes.density_threshold_refitting: closed by V101 and not reopened
closed_axes.full_five_component_pareto: safe but behaviorally inert in V105

hypothesis.primary: Task-count LoadLeast can prefer a node whose CPU or memory headroom is worse for the moved function. Protecting resource headroom while retaining V105 critical-frontier and locality safeguards should prevent the observed path-dependent regressions without requiring every auxiliary FaaSRank component to be nonworse.
hypothesis.arm_a: CPU headroom and memory headroom must each be nonworse than the exact V94 anchor node.
hypothesis.arm_b: The minimum of CPU and memory headroom and their sum must each be nonworse than the exact V94 anchor node, allowing a bounded trade between resource dimensions without worsening the bottleneck or total headroom.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if neither candidate passes every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E887-E889 cohort.

allowed: immutable captured DAG edges and per-function CPU/output size
current request's collected and placement-feasible player set
deterministic remaining critical-path rank already used by frozen SRPT-ready ordering
current same-window CPU and memory headroom components computed by the frozen FaaSRank proxy
current common candidate, container, queue, bandwidth, and same-window assignment state
frozen tape, SLA, reference, and V94 certificates
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, or SLA outcome fields
future arrivals, future child placement, or future container feasibility
workload scenario label as a routing input
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.resource_headroom_definition: Use the existing finite FaaSRank operational cpu_headroom and memory_headroom components for the current player, anchor node, candidate node, and same partial assignment; missing/nonfinite components fail closed.

arms.current_player_safety: V105 scalar safety plus CPU and memory headroom each nonworse
V105 scalar safety plus resource bottleneck and total headroom nonworse

candidate_mechanism.density_band: retain V105: nonterminal substitutions only at queue density >=8 and every substitution only while whole-window density <24
candidate_mechanism.critical_frontier_protection: retain V105 exactly: protect missing/nonfinite rank, singleton frontier, and every rank tied at the request-local maximum
candidate_mechanism.resource_pareto_mode: require both current FaaSRank CPU and memory headroom components to be individually nonworse
candidate_mechanism.resource_bottleneck_sum_mode: require both the current minimum resource headroom and total resource headroom to be nonworse
candidate_mechanism.other_component_policy: do not require warm_affinity, load_balance, or diversity componentwise because warmness is independently preserved, ranked candidates already strictly reduce projected LoadLeast load, and the complete routed score remains nonworse
candidate_mechanism.coordination_acceptance: exact frozen V94 dual window-safe routed-expert, OCS, and immutable-baseline-welfare noninferiority guard without a LoadLeast window certificate
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: When no resource-safe unprotected initializer substitution is accepted, dispatch exactly the V94 assignment for identical current state and candidates.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged

per_window: load_least gate evaluated/accepted/reason and substitution counts
performance fields retained but not opened before blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain, then minimum relative throughput change, then prefer resource Pareto safety, then arm_id
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select a V106 profile
